localChanges: New Game now opens one window offering Civilization, Civilization II or Customise…, and a game you pick starts straight after the difficulty: on the square grid for Civilization and the isometric grid for Civilization II, at a normal size with 7 civilizations, or however you last started that game. A line under each game says what it will start with (#1247).
Customise… opens the game setup, where you can choose the original rules, the grid, the exact world and the rest.
